characters.summary: Ice Mario fights by tossing glowing blue iceballs that can freeze various enemies solid. He retains his standard jumping abilities while gaining elemental projectile attacks.

mechanisms: Standard Mario durability enhanced by freezing attackers on contact or projectiles

weaknesses: Vulnerable to losing the power-up upon taking damage
limitations: Power-up wears off upon taking enemy damage
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard attacks with iceball projections and grants ice elemental properties.

sources.supports: Ice Mario abilities, iceball attacks, and power-up mechanics.

feats.claim: Froze opponents using icy projectiles thrown from his hands.

campaignTags.claim: Can throw iceballs that freeze enemies.

unknowns: Exact duration of the Ice Flower transformation across different game engines.

characters.summary: Mega Mario grows to colossal proportions, allowing him to smash through obstacles, terrain, and enemies with absolute ease. He operates as a moving engine of destruction for a limited time.

mechanisms: Immunity to ordinary hazards and enemies due to massive size

limitations: Strict time limit before returning to normal size
characters.formDifferences: Enlarges Mario to gigantic proportions, granting complete invulnerability to normal obstacles and destructive momentum.

sources.supports: Mega Mario size increase, destruction feats, and time limit.

feats.claim: Flattened entire groups of enemies and destroyed obstacle blocks effortlessly.

campaignTags.claim: Grows to colossal size via Mega Mushroom.

unknowns: Whether environmental bosses can resist being crushed by Mega Mario.

characters.summary: Metal Mario is completely encased in solid metal, rendering him immune to most damage, heat, and enemy attacks while causing him to sink directly to underwater floors.

mechanisms: Metal skin providing immunity to standard attacks, fire, and toxic gas

weaknesses: Cannot swim and sinks instantly in water
limitations: Temporary duration tied to the Metal Cap timer
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Mario into a metallic form with increased weight, immunity to hazards, and inability to swim.

sources.supports: Metal Cap properties, invulnerability, and sinking mechanics.

feats.claim: Walked underwater along lake beds without needing to breathe.

unknowns: Interaction of Metal Mario with extreme magical or reality-warping attacks.

characters.summary: Starman Mario glows with multicolored rainbow energy, granting complete invulnerability to almost all hazards and enemies upon physical contact.

mechanisms: Complete invincibility against enemies and environmental damage

limitations: Lasts only for a brief number of seconds
characters.formDifferences: Grants temporary invulnerability and fast movement speed.

sources.supports: Super Star invincibility mechanics and duration.

feats.claim: Defeated any touched enemy instantly while flashing with invincible energy.

unknowns: Whether bottomless pits or crushing geometry can still incapacitate Starman Mario.

characters.summary: Tanooki Mario wears a raccoon-like suit that permits brief flights, tail-whipping attacks, and temporary transformation into an invincible stone statue.

mechanisms: Statue transformation providing complete immunity while stationary

weaknesses: Statue form cannot move while active
limitations: Flight requires a running start to build momentum
characters.formDifferences: Adds a tail attack, gliding capability, and stone statue transformation.

sources.supports: Tanooki suit abilities including tail attack, floating, and statue transformation.

feats.claim: Turned into an unyielding stone statue to avoid enemy attacks.

conditional.ability: Tail whipping, gliding, and statue transformation

campaignTags.claim: Can slow descent and glide using the raccoon tail.

unknowns: Exact duration limit of the stone statue form in newer game iterations.

characters.summary: Master Chief is a genetically augmented supersoldier encased in powered MJOLNIR armor, utilizing advanced firearms, energy shields, and tactical explosives in combat.
weaknesses: Shields deplete under sustained heavy fire or EMP blasts
limitations: Ammunition limits require scavenging or weapon swapping

sources.supports: Master Chief combat abilities, MJOLNIR armor, and weapons arsenal.

feats.claim: Destroyed a Covenant Halo installation ring and survived deep space exposure.

notableResults.note: Defeated with assistance from Cortana and a pulse grenade.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes advanced Covenant and UNSC weaponry and HUD technology.

unknowns: Exact physiological limits of SPARTAN-II augmentations without armor.

characters.summary: Mega Man is a fighting robot who fires plasma projectiles from his Mega Buster arm cannon and copies the special weapons of defeated robot masters.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to extreme energy overloads and specific elemental counter-weapons
limitations: Special weapon ammunition drains with use and must be refilled

sources.supports: Mega Man abilities, Mega Buster, and weapon copying system.

feats.claim: Defeated Dr. Wily's army of custom Robot Masters across multiple campaigns.

campaignTags.claim: Is a sentient fighting robot created by Dr. Light.
Uses advanced robotic weaponry and arm cannon technology.

unknowns: Exact processing capacity of Mega Man's neural net compared to later series replicas.

characters.summary: Super Adapter Mega Man combines with Rush to form an armored powerhouse capable of flight and firing high-powered mega punches and charged energy blasts.
weaknesses: Bulky form reduces agile ground sliding
limitations: Flight energy is limited and must recharge
characters.formDifferences: Adds powered flight, projectile rocket fists, and enhanced chest cannon power at the cost of standard sliding.

sources.supports: Super Adapter fusion mechanics, flight, and rocket punch abilities.

feats.claim: Flew and demolished heavily shielded fortress defenses using rocket punches.

campaignTags.claim: Can fly using jet boosters attached via the Super Adapter.
Equipped with advanced fusion armor and rocket attachments.

unknowns: Compatibility of the Super Adapter with weapons outside the standard Mega Buster.

characters.summary: Meta Knight is a skilled swordsman wielding the sacred blade Galaxia, possessing lightning-fast reflexes, bat-like wings for flight, and mastery of dimensional cuts.
limitations: Melee weapon range unless projecting energy arcs

sources.supports: Meta Knight's sword skills, Galaxia, wings, and special attacks.

feats.claim: Fought evenly against cosmic warriors and navigated his flying battleship Halberd.

notableResults.note: Defeated in single combat aboard the Halberd.

campaignTags.claim: Can fly using innate bat-like wings.
Can vanish or wrap himself in his cape to hide.

unknowns: Meta Knight's exact biological origins relative to Kirby's species.
